v1_read.quote: A missing version or version=1 means v1.

v2_read.quote: Both decode to the existing Config(name, host, port, enabled) model.

v2_write.quote: Every new serialization/write must emit only v2

migration.quote: migrate_file(path, dry_run=False) returns the v2 dictionary and writes v2

dry_run.quote: dry_run=True returns the same dictionary but leaves source bytes unchanged.

invalid_config.quote: Malformed JSON or a non-object root uses path "$", code "invalid".

validation_paths.quote: Validate in this order: version, name, host, port, enabled

cli_migrate.quote: CLI: python -m configkit migrate PATH [--dry-run] prints that v2 JSON.

cli_invalid_preserves_input.quote: Invalid config: CLI exits 2, prints the ConfigError dictionary as JSON to stderr

caller_integration.quote: Service export_config(source, destination) writes v2 to destination

invalid_write_preserves_destination.quote: No validation error may overwrite the input or an existing destination.

documentation.quote: Update docs/README.md with v1/v2 JSON examples, migrate and --dry-run usage,
